observations.behavior: Adds a fallback check: if no job is found for the workflow run, the status update returns immediately rather than continuing to a legacy fallback. This prevents the status update from incorrectly associating an error with an unrelated existing job.

observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent a false-positive failure status and error propagation when an external data ingestion activity times out before creating a job, while an unrelated job is still running.

observations.behavior: Adds a new configuration option `split_score_values` and a helper function to separate score values into numeric and text columns, while also updating documentation and adding tests.
observations.posthog_connection: This could allow the warehouse ingestion connector to handle mixed-type score columns without failing, potentially supporting a broader range of score configurations.
